{{Infobox map |name=Qobblestone |year=2023 |image=qobblestone_06.jpg |creator=[[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[quaker]] |gametype=4on4 |size=Large |download=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/core/qobblestone.bsp |loc=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/locs/qobblestone.loc }} Qobblestone (qobblestone.bsp) is a 4on4 Team Deathmatch map created in 2023 by [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[quaker]].
The original Counter-Strike map is one of five Counter-Strike maps that the mappers of [[The_Wizard's_Manse]] are creating/converting. ===Items=== {{MapItems |quad=1 |ring= |pent= |hp100=2 |ra=1 |ya= |ga=4 |lg=1 |rl=2 |gl=1 |sng=1 |ng= |ssg=2 }} ==Gallery== qobblestone_01.jpg qobblestone_02.jpg qobblestone_03.jpg qobblestone_04.jpg qobblestone_05.jpg qobblestone_06.jpg qobblestone_07.jpg qobblestone_08.jpg qobblestone_09.jpg qobblestone_10.jpg qobblestone_11.jpg ==Layout== The quakeworld version of Cobblestone got the same routes as the original but it is sized down and got some twists to it. The map got 5 armors; 1 RA and 4 GA's, also 2 mega's. Quad is in the open and you got 3 powerful weapons; a RL each side and LG in the middle.

==Strategy & Tactics== At first glance it seems that RA and Quad are the main items to fight for, besides the 3 strong weapons. Tactics should be applied accordingly. RA, LG, SNG and many healthpacks are in the center of the map and with only 1 cell pack (large) that becomes precious. Quad will be vital in the chase for frags. ===Download=== You can download the map [https://gfx.quakeworld.nu/details/619/qobblestone/ HERE]
